apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.tagline: Your films and shows, streamed to every screen.
apps.description: Jellyfin organises the films, shows and music in your media folder, with posters and details, and plays them in a browser, on phones and on TVs. It only reads your media, never changes it. Its library and settings are kept in its own folder, and its cache in memory, to spare the SD card.

apps.name: Navidrome
apps.description: Navidrome turns the music in your media folder into your own streaming service, in a browser or in any app that speaks Subsonic. It only reads your media, never changes it. The first person to open it makes the admin account.

apps.name: Audiobookshelf
apps.tagline: Audiobooks and podcasts, with your place kept.
apps.description: Audiobookshelf plays the audiobooks in your media folder and keeps up with podcasts, remembering where everyone left off, in a browser or its phone apps. It only reads your media. Podcasts it downloads go in its own folder. The first person to open it makes the main account.

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.tagline: Knows when your sites and services go down.
apps.description: Uptime Kuma checks websites, servers and services as often as every 20 seconds, keeps a history, and can tell you on Discord, Telegram, email and many more when something stops answering. It can also show a public status page. The first visit sets up its admin account.

apps.name: Homebox
apps.tagline: Everything you own, and where you put it.
apps.description: Homebox keeps a list of your things, where they are, what they cost and when their warranties end, with labels, photos and receipts. Make an account on the first visit. Its secret key is made fresh for this machine when it's installed.

apps.name: Mealie
apps.tagline: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.
apps.description: Mealie keeps your recipes in one place, can pull them from a website's address, and plans meals and shopping lists from them. Sign in the first time with the starting account in Mealie's own guide, then change its email and password straight away.

apps.name: Memos
apps.tagline: Quick notes, like a timeline only you read.
apps.description: Memos is a place to jot things down fast, in Markdown, with tags and search, and come back to them later. The first account made becomes its admin.

apps.name: FreshRSS
apps.tagline: The sites you follow, in one place.
apps.description: FreshRSS gathers the newest posts from the websites and blogs you follow, so you read them in one place, without ads or a feed deciding for you. A short setup on the first visit makes your account.

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.tagline: A whiteboard for sketches that look hand-drawn.
apps.description: Excalidraw is a whiteboard for quick diagrams and sketches with a hand-drawn look. This one keeps your drawings in its own folder, so they're still there next time. No account needed.

apps.name: IT-Tools
apps.tagline: Handy tools for developers, in one page.
apps.description: IT-Tools gathers dozens of small tools in one place: converting between formats, making passwords and QR codes, decoding tokens, and more. Everything runs in your browser, and nothing is kept. No account needed.

apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.tagline: Downloads torrents, from a web page.
apps.description: qBittorrent downloads torrents into the downloads folder in your media, where Jellyfin and the others can find them. It can search through Jackett when that's installed too. To keep your downloads private, tick "A VPN for everything it does" in its form and add your NordVPN service sign-in. Its first password is printed in its Logs. Downloading writes to the disk a lot, so a plugged-in disk is kinder than the SD card.

apps.name: Jackett
apps.tagline: Lets your other apps search torrent sites.
apps.description: Jackett speaks to many torrent sites in one common way, so apps like qBittorrent can search them all at once. Add the sites you use in its page. On its own it downloads nothing. It comes with FlareSolverr, which gets past the "checking your browser" pages some sites put up: in Jackett's settings its address is http://flaresolverr:8191. It can go through your VPN too, with "A VPN for everything it does" in its form.

apps.name: Stremio server
apps.tagline: The streaming part of Stremio, on your own machine.
apps.description: Stremio is an app for your TV, phone or computer that plays films and shows through add-ons. This is its server, which does the streaming work for the app. In the Stremio app, choose this machine's address with port 11470 as its streaming server.
